title: prainea limpato subsp. papuana
intro: Prainea limpato subsp. papuana, commonly known as the Papuan Prainea, is a plant species native to Papua New Guinea. It is used in traditional medicine to treat various health conditions, including fever, rheumatism, and skin infections, due to its reported health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Prainea limpato subsp. papuana include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antipyretic effects, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including alkaloids, flavonoids, and saponins. Further research is needed to confirm the exact bioactive constituents and their therapeutic actions.
